ols.interpretation: A 1-unit increase in sub_qib is associated with a 0.0148 change in gmp_pct (n=164, R²=0.136). The slope is statistically distinguishable from zero at 5%. This is an association, not a causal claim.
caveats: HC3 robust standard errors relax homoskedasticity; they do not create identification.
A low p-value does not imply a tradable edge after costs, allotment and multiple testing.
Cross-sectional IPO OLS has clustered time effects (IPO waves).
